messages:
Mira Chen: noticed flip-flop in staging: scorer keeps switching to cheaper eu pools then p99 spikes. wondering if we should add hysteresis or per-tenant latency floors.

Arjun Rao: propose two-tier decision: health-checks (instant) + preference scoring with commit window.

Becky Li: hysteresis idea: require candidate to be X% better for N seconds. defaults: 5% and 30s. make configurable but bounded.

Samir: add headroom into telemetry bag (headroom_ratio). scorer should penalize low headroom. avoids overload amplification.

Lia Ops: must have circuit-breaker: if headroom < threshold disqualify route for T seconds and alert. also one-click rollback in console.

Mira Chen: runtime design: keep scorer pure/stateless (telemetry bag only). smoothing/commit state lives in routing layer as atomic struct {score,last_update,cooldown_until}.

Becky Li: normalize cost by region-model baseline to avoid raw cost bias. blend recent and long-term medians to avoid staleness.

Arjun Rao: testing: simulate spiky traffic, replay real traces, fuzz baseline updates. add sim-run to console rollout path.

Mira Chen: decision summary: implement health-first + smoothed commit, add headroom signal + circuit-breaker, normalize cost by baseline, expose commit_window and delta_pct in profiles (bounded), require sim-run + canary before enabling tenant overrides.
